summary: Penn Mountain lookout, Oneida County NY: 80-ft Aermotor LS40 tower built 1950, lookout work ended 1971, reopened briefly 1974, removed 1976.

facts.design: Aermotor LS40 steel lookout tower, 80 ft
facts.status_note: Removed in 1976 (Wikipedia). The Starr list and CNY Hiking also mark it removed. No source read describes the site now.

events.note: Conservation Department built an 80-foot Aermotor LS40 steel tower on the mountain. The Starr list also dates it to 1950.
Tower went into service, reporting no fires and four visitors.
Reopened briefly to provide early detection to an area hit by wind damage near Forestport, then closed again.
Removed, per Wikipedia. The Starr list and CNY Hiking mark it removed.

notes_for_editor: County conflict: Wikipedia and the FFLA county list say Oneida; the Starr list and CNY Hiking say Herkimer. The story keeps Oneida and reports the disagreement. Elevation also differs (Wikipedia 1,808 ft, Starr list 1,813 ft); no elevation is used in the story. PeakVisor gives a point about 7 km east of the FFLA and GNIS coordinates; it was not used. An FFLA NY Facebook post (seen only in search results, page text not readable) mentions a 1941 model observer's cabin and a telephone line; not used, because it was not read. No source read describes the site today, public access or any remains; access and visit facts are left out. The brief's record (Oneida County, gone) matches the sources, so no corrections are proposed.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Wikipedia and the FFLA county list give Oneida. The Starr list and CNY Hiking give Herkimer. The story keeps Oneida, which two sources state, and reports the disagreement.
Wikipedia gives 1,808 ft and the Starr list gives 1,813 ft. Elevation is not used in the story.
